Biden's DOJ went after Christian parents, nuns, Catholic Churches, & discriminated at every turn. 

Whether Biden shared the bigotry or was just too senile to know makes no difference--his Admin was the most anti-Christian in history.  

I commend @POTUS for reversing this.

For 76 days, Democrats shut down DHS to try to protect criminal illegal aliens from deportation.

The shutdown is over. It was a disgrace. 

Chuck Schumer cares more about criminal illegal aliens than he cares about you.

Democrats are rallying behind a self-described Communist with a nazi tattoo in Maine. The party has lost its mind. 

Susan Collins has spent her career standing up and delivering for Maine families. 

She’s ready to win this fight.

Obama has supported and campaigned for every outrageous Democratic gerrymander, including in Illinois. 

But now he puts out a sanctimonious statement when the Supreme Court rightfully blocks racial discrimination in redistricting. 

What a fraud.


Barack Obama (@BarackObama)

Today’s Supreme Court decision effectively guts a key pillar of the Voting Rights Act, freeing state legislatures to gerrymander legislative districts to systematically dilute and weaken the voting power of racial minorit

I strongly commend the @TheJusticeDept for going after the Somali fraudsters who, with the tacit blessing of Tim Walz and Minnesota Dems, stole billions from taxpayers. 

These criminals made life less affordable for Arkansans and every American. 

Prosecute them and deport them.

Kamala Harris caused record inflation, chaos at the border, and pushed trans surgeries on kids. Her values are the opposite of Arkansas's values. 

It's striking to see Arkansas Democrats embrace Kamala and her policies. 

And it's another reason to vote Republican this fall.

For years, I’ve called for action against the defamation factory called the SPLC.

The SPLC’s business model is lying about Christians and conservatives. 

I commend @FBIDirectorKash and @TheJusticeDept for acting against this group of con artists.
